The best part that almost nobody talks about is their optional packing service. The counter staff suggested it to us because we originally thought of buying two boxes and packing everything ourselves. Instead, this uncle there professionally packed EVERYTHING into one giant box for us so it became much more affordable. The packing service cost 30,000 won CASH ONLY and it included: - The giant box - Bubble wrap/paper wraps - All the tapes and protective wrapping materials - The uncle packing everything securely for you And honestly… he packed it SO well. We were genuinely impressed by how experienced and efficient he was. Everything was tightly packed, protected, and organised perfectly. We paid around 140,000 won for EMS shipping for 22kg to Singapore, so altogether with the packing service, it was about 170,000 won total to ship everything home. SO worth it compared to dragging 22kg worth of extra luggage through train stations, airport transfers, stairs, and onto the plane. If you only have a small amount of items and want to DIY, they do provide paper wrapping materials and lots of tape there. The boxes are charged separately though. You’ll need to: 1. Take a queue ticket to purchase the box 2. Pack everything yourself 3. Take another queue number to pay for shipping There’s also an aunty there who speaks English and helps guide foreigners around, including helping you choose the correct queue number, so don’t stress too much if it feels confusing at first. For anyone looking for it: The international postage/EMS section is located in the basement, all the way to the left corner. And in case the English-speaking aunty isn’t around: - Press LEFT for buying boxes - Press RIGHT for the queue ticket to pay for shipping Would 100% do this again instead of suffering at the airport with overweight luggage.
